title: Well, it is Cute, Right?
text:
Well, it is Cute, Right?. When was the last time you changed your shower curtain? We have two showers in our house, one with a glass door and the other with a curtain. It has been years since we changed the curtain, so when presented with this opportunity, I went ahead and grabbed it.

With its pink colors, my girls- the primary users of the bathroom with the shower curtain- liked what they saw. I agree that the colors are pleasant and since my girls’ bathroom is neutral in color anyway, it was very easy to place this curtain and matching mat in the bathroom without anything looking weird. The more feminine colors make it good choice for a girls bathroom so in this respect, the curtain/rug combo earns some points.

However, this set from Oceanique loses points in other ways and one of them is with the shower hooks. They do not slide very well along the shower rod, due to their metal construction sliding against the metal rod. They seem cheap, too, and are not completely closed, rounded hooks. That makes it easy to remove the curtain and the hooks because they lift right off without little effort. But it’s bad because it means the hooks can pop off as you try to move the curtain back and forth. Rounded hooks take more effort to attach and remove, but they are more secure.

Looking at the quality of the material used for the shower curtain and the mat, well, they seem okay but not anything great. When I think about the going price for this set, it does seem a little high for what you get and I notice that other reviewers have made similar observations. I do like that the mat stays in place on the floor and doesn’t slide around but it seems a little too thin. And I also wish the set came with a liner. You have to supply this yourself, which seems unfair when you consider the price. The manufacturer should have included this.

Shower curtains need occasional upgrades and the Oceanique shower curtain/bathroom mat set seems like an acceptable option. I know there are better curtains on the market and I still think the set is overpriced. But it does have enough going for it- including the fact that my girls like it- to make it worth a look.
